stories.title: U.K. sanctions Israeli companies involved in building illegal settlements in West Bank

stories.title: Why Democrat Mary Peltola’s US Senate win in Alaska matters
stories.summary: Peltola’s Alaska win gives Democrats 56 Senate seats and a buffer in Republican states ahead of the 2028 elections.
stories.detail: Republican incumbent beaten in race dominated by controversy over second candidate named Dan Sullivan Democrat Mary Peltola will be Alaska’s next senator after beating the Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan, with the result called two weeks on from midterm elections which saw Donald Trump’s party lose ground across the country. Peltola, a former US House lawmaker, is the first Democrat the state has elected to the Senate since 2008. Her victory comes just two years after Alaska voters unseated her while supporting Trump by a double-digit margin.
